description: How many NFTs of one ERC-721 collection a wallet holds on Optimism (balanceOf), with the collection's name and symbol. Use to check a holder before a token-gated action or to see whether a wallet still holds a collection; for who holds one token id use op_nft_owner. Both inputs are 0x addresses; a missing contract is 404, a contract that is not ERC-721 422, both uncharged. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
name: op_nft_balance
title: Optimism NFT balance
